@description:
 [Lifestyle] This is the character who seeks his fame and fortune by
 exploration and taking risks with his own life. The adventurer is at home in
 most types of inhabited places as well as many kinds of wilderness locales.
 Time to Acquire: 24 months. Starting Money: normal plus d10 (open-ended).
